mentions.name: Sivic
mentions.description: A website that uses AI guided toward neutral, non-partisan analysis of government actions from source documents. It generates a summary, expected effects, benefits, disadvantages, and ranks each action against 19 "things you care about" areas such as defence, environment, civil liberties, and religious protection.
mentions.problem: Discussion of contentious government actions on social spaces like Reddit or X consists of strident left or right takes that are neither informative nor helpful.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I am setting up a site which uses AI which is specifically guided to be neutral and non-partisan, to analyse the government actions from the source documents.
